purpose: On the already pinned 684 historical 2012–2025 BTC/Fed/NFCI/ANFCI Sundays, test whether authentic as-of 4-week changes in US real yields, broad USD and yield curve improve BTC upside selection or downside risk identification.

DFII10.fourWeekDelta: latest official real 10-year TIPS percent yield minus as-of earlier valid value 25-35 calendar days before latest

DTWEXBGS.fourWeekDelta: latest official Fed H.10 broad trade-weighted USD index less 25-35 calendar days earlier
DTWEXBGS.warning: Series historically unavailable as of 2013/2017 due revised series introduction; do not substitute current backfilled data; 2019 methodology shift and later rebasing documented.

T10Y2Y.fourWeekDelta: 10-2 year nominal Treasury spread in percent, 4wk change
T10Y2Y.stress: spread<0 inversion or delta<0 flattening descriptive; not presumed near-term bitcoin bear indicator
T10Y2Y.warning: 2013 pilot as-of vintage gave 400, do not assume earlier data

query: FRED series observations exact realtime_start=realtime_end=frozen Sunday; 66 calendar day observation lookback ending as-of Sunday; last observation lag2-11 calendar days; >=3 validated numeric values and at least one 25-35 days before latest. Each original JSON body and per-body SHA archived in R2 with unique versioned object key.
rateLimit: Steady no faster than 1.2 requests per second aggregate with bounded retry/backoff for 429; missing 400=>SOURCE_NOT_AVAILABLE (not false negative), failed 429=>HTTP429_UNRESOLVED not economic datum. Preserve source errors and included sample n.
targets: v8.17.1 immutable future path outcomes: UP13 >=20%, UP26 >=50%, UP52 >=100% gain reached, DOWN13 <= -20%, DOWN26<=-35%, DOWN52 <= -50% daily close below signal reference, positive close horizons 13/26/52. No redefinition.

candidates.MACRO_STRICT: v8.17.1 STRICT_MACRO = improving Fed + both Chicago indexes
candidates.ALL_OLD: v8.17.1 STRICT_ALL BTC AND Fed AND both Chicago indices
candidates.DOWN_OLD: v8.17.1 NEG_ALL = no positive BTC trend and worsening all macro
candidates.REAL_AND_USD_TIGHT_NO_BTC: REAL_TIGHT AND DOLLAR_STRONG AND NOT BTC_A

comparisons: For each factor and combination, all conditions including baseline models compared on EXACT same factor-available dates (not 684 for USD). Compare 684 original full sample separately only for provenance. Calculate TP FP FN TN, count, PPV, recall, adverse20/35 and positive13/26, 26wk median. Results by 2012, 2013-2016, 2017-2019, 2020-23, 2024-25 and locked alerts >=14 and >=27 weeks.
preRegisteredControls: Real yields tightening predicts risk hypothetically, easing may support upside. A simple binary 4-week sign is arbitrary; no learned coefficients, interactions predeclared. Report ALL candidates, do not select best apparent historical rate as proven edge. No p-values, small event count cautions.
quality: All original 684 rows preserved byte-for-byte after additive features and output; no revisions to v8.17.1, no using 2026 live values as 2012. Last eligible weekly outcome 2025-10-12; not OOS.
pipeline: Rate limit isolated source acquisition can span multiple execution runs; report partial as incomplete, and DO NOT claim full panel until source and analytics SHA manifest reread pass.
future: After macro independent-factor evidence proceed to chain MVRV/realized capitalization PIT audit, Korea alt liquidity and global macro geopolitical/crypto contagion context on hourly sourced timestamps.
safety: RESEARCH_ONLY. Do not change Spot, Futures, NAV, P&L, capital, reserve, MASTER, Detector, trade limits or create trading automation.
